terra.problem: Micah 3:12 says Zion will be plowed like a field; it does not say the mountain of the house will be plowed over. The explanation treats them as the same place without establishing that connection.
The claim that a mountain is split elsewhere in the Bible needs a reference.
Saying nothing gets cracked in half rules out a detail the passage does not address.
The passage does not say the peoples can see the mountain. The claim that they cannot stream toward something they cannot see is unsupported.
The nations say they want to learn God's ways, but the passage does not say they are not coming to be impressive.
The passage does not say the nations are not coming to move in.
The passage says nations will no longer take up the sword against one another or train for war. Saying all fighting stops goes beyond that.
The passage says nations will no longer take up the sword against one another or train for war. Saying there will be no fighting goes beyond that.
No one will frighten the man, but the passage does not say he will not look over his shoulder.
The passage says there will be no one to frighten him, not that fear itself is missing. It also does not say there will be plenty going on around the vine and fig tree.
The passage says there will be no one to frighten him, not that fear is the only thing gone. It also does not say anyone has to share the figs.
Saying the LORD starts with the ones left out adds an order to His gathering that the passage does not give.
The passage says the LORD will rule from that day and forever. It does not say His rule starts that day.

The promise that former dominion will be restored does not establish that nothing gets taken away.
